✨ 7 Body Care Ingredients That Actually Work Body concerns can feel confusing, but choosing the right ingredient makes it much easier 👀 Strawberry skin → Lactic acid Rough lips → Vaseline Body acne → Benzoyl peroxide Dark armpits → Niacinamide Ingrown hair → Salicylic acid Sweaty pits → Aluminum chloride Neck lines → Retinal Lactic acid can help smooth rough, bumpy-looking skin, Vaseline helps lock in moisture for dry lips, benzoyl peroxide is commonly used for body acne, and niacinamide can help support a more even-looking skin tone. Salicylic acid helps with clogged pores and ingrown hairs, aluminum chloride is commonly used to reduce excessive sweating, and retinal can help improve the appearance of fine lines over time. Some active ingredients can be irritating if overused, so start slowly and adjust based on your skin. finally did a skincare routine 🦦💗 this is just what i use and it might not work for everyone! i found the best way to treat my acne and other skin issues was learning more about my skin (my skin type, what kind of acne with my dermatologist) and my biggest piece of advice for anyone who is dealing with skin issues: it’s not permanent and things take time! a pimple can take 1-2 weeks to form and a few more to go away and a lot of products take just as long to show results. i learned to normalize acne/skin issues because everyone goes through them and that’s helped my anxiety/stress when it comes to how my skin looks so much. i’ll probably make another video about how i desensitized myself to my skin issues and how important that is 🤍 i just started up tretinoin a month ago at 0.025% twice a week and my skin has been incredibly dry but i think i’ve finished most of the purging 🙂 excited to see more results from it! products 🪽: @mixsoon_official bean cleansing oil + centella cleansing foam @anua.skincare_us toner pads @mediheal_official tea tree toner pads @Pyunkang Yul (편강율) essence toner @imfrom_global mugwort essence @apieu.official madecassoside cream 2x tretinoin 0.025% (prescription) @Kiehl’s Since 1851 avocado eye cream @Laniege_us lip sleeping mask #skincare #skincareroutine #skincareproducts #koreanskincare #asianskincare #koreanskincareroutine #koreanskin #glassskin #acnetreatment
